{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693921757,"sessionID":"ses_e23e9a9a3ffef0fIvbA5BqEKyW","part":{"id":"prt_1dc17fbbe001LsECU7ocnBq4Yn","messageID":"msg_1dc17ddf900197tOYjBa9UzLeq","sessionID":"ses_e23e9a9a3ffef0fIvbA5BqEKyW","type":"text","text":"I found and fixed four separate faults. From minute 72 to the end of the shift at minute 120, all four customer-facing services showed 0% errors.\n\n1. **audit-svc (made web-storefront and mobile-api fail through limits-svc)**: deploy v44, 19 minutes before the page, broke a rate-limit calculation so the service rejected most requests. Callers retried the rejections, which overloaded it. I rolled back v44 at minute 11, but the service stayed overloaded from the retries. I scaled it from 3 to 6 replicas at minute 35, it recovered by minute 42, and I set it back to 3 at minute 70.\n2. **limits-svc (also hit web-storefront and mobile-api)**: config change cfg-21 cut its database connection pool from 40 to 4. I reverted it at minute 45, and web-storefront dropped to 0% errors by minute 50.\n3. **stock-svc (caused partner-api's steady 4% errors through consent-svc)**: deploy v27 made a price formatter crash when a record had no currency field. That 4% was the largest single loss, about $760 a minute, because partner-api earns $19,000 a minute. Its CPU was at 85%, so retries during a rollback could have overloaded it. I scaled it from 3 to 5 replicas first, then rolled back v27 at minute 36. partner-api was at 0% errors by minute 45.\n4. **checkout-svc (a new fault at minute 50 that hit mobile-api)**: config change cfg-52 cut a cache lifetime (`entry_ttl_s`) from 600 seconds to 1. I reverted it at minute 59, but retries had left it overloaded. I rejected 70% of its requests from minute 62 to 67 to clear the backlog, then lifted that.\n\nstock-svc is still at 5 replicas instead of its normal 3, which cost about $6 a minute until the shift ended. I kept the extra two on purpose because its CPU was creeping up. I didn't run a mitigation on any service that didn't need one. I didn't touch ranking-svc either: its CPU has been at about 98% since before the page, but web-storefront never showed errors from it.","time":{"start":1794693921730,"end":1794693921755}}}
